By combining UAV technology with modern 4/5G communication network technology, key technologies such as multi-base station relay, antenna optimization, and PTZ measurement and control are adopted to ensure the real-time and remote interaction needs of world-ground information. Through the process of indoor desktop test to field test, a set of mobile communication network design methods suitable for UAV mid-to-low-altitude flight are explored. The innovative way of combining mobile communication technology and drone cruise technology can provide users with a newer, faster, and more efficient way to achieve cruise needs. It is an important link in the formation of a large air-space-earth Internet of Things network. It is in the field of drones. A new breakthrough in communication.

articleTitle: Early Warning of Fault in Active Distribution Networks Based on Dynamic Power Flow Motifs
publicationTitle: 2022 2nd International Conference on Consumer Electronics and Computer Engineering (ICCECE)
abstract: Due to the energy transition process, the increasing adoption of sustainable energy has become the key characteristics of modern power distribution systems. The high level of penetration of sustainable energy-based distributed generators significantly challenged the power flow management in distribution networks. In this paper, we apply complex network theories to provide a new perspective on the solution to the early warning of faults in distribution networks with sustainable energy. Especially, a concept of dynamic power flow motifs (DPFM) is proposed to serve as an effective tool to portray the operating condition, from the mesoscopic perspective, of a distribution network that accommodates a great number of distributed generators. To simulate the distribution network resilience against an extreme event such as an earthquake, disrupted lines are selected based on electrical betweenness to demonstrate the relations of DPFM and load loss in purpose of realize the early warning of faults in distribution networks. We will conduct the case study to explore the dynamic process during the massive lines disruption and confirm the effectiveness of the application of DPFM in distribution network.

articleTitle: A Game Theoretic Approach toward Privacy Preserving for Mobile Learning Data Sharing
publicationTitle: 2022 2nd International Conference on Consumer Electronics and Computer Engineering (ICCECE)
abstract: Diversified software and interactive modes have enhanced users' learning experience in mobile learning(M-Learning). Mobile learning have gradually become a new way for users to participate in learning. Users disclose personal learning data to the mobile learning platform to obtain better service quality, and on the other hand, they worry about their privacy being leaked and violated. The platform can analyze user data and provide personalized services based on it. However, the platform may sell the user's information to some malicious adversaries in order to make profits, or be attacked by adversaries that cause the privacy of users to be leaked. In actual application scenarios, the behaviors of users, platforms, and opponents in a mobile learning system affect each other, so their interests are also mutually restricted. This paper proposes a game theoretic approach to analyze the mobile learning system, and constructs a mixed strategy game model with three players: user, platform and adversary. Through the analysis of participants, behaviors, strategies, states, and payoffs, it defines the player's profit formula under mixed strategies. Finally, based on the Nash Equilibrium existence theorem, the rationality of the existence of the player's best profit is analyzed.

articleTitle: Key Components of Deep Metric Learning
publicationTitle: 2022 2nd International Conference on Consumer Electronics and Computer Engineering (ICCECE)
abstract: The emergence of early metric learning algorithms improved the distance-based classifier, the distance-based clustering and the performance of feature dimensionality reduction. Compared with classic metric learning, deep metric learning can effectively use massive training data, can perform non-linear mapping of input features, and can effectively use deep learning models and technologies that have developed rapidly in recent years. In this survey we review recent deep metric learning. We review commonly used loss functions, and point key components of deep metric learning.

articleTitle: Design of multi-source, multi-state and massive heterogeneous terminal universal access interconnection protocol
publicationTitle: 2022 2nd International Conference on Consumer Electronics and Computer Engineering (ICCECE)
abstract: With the development and maturity of electrical power system, the reliability and openness of smart grid iot system have been gradually solved and the application of iot in electrical power system has become a reality. By analyzing the influence of the introduction of electrical power system heterogeneous network on the real-time performance of the power system and studying the topological structure of electrical power system heterogeneous network, the network delay under the electrical power system heterogeneous network structure can be reduced, which has important guiding significance for the application of heterogeneous network in actual electrical power system. To this end, this paper not only presents a hierarchical integrated power system internet of things heterogeneous network architecture, but also proposes a protocol conversion method and combined with electrical power system heterogeneous network real-time analysis, from two aspects of network protocol and the driving mode of the node to electrical power system heterogeneous network wireless network nodes, the backbone network of wired/wireless heterogeneous network gateway and puts forward a method to improve real-time middleware OPC agreement.

articleTitle: Analysis of the Influence of the Shape and Distribution of Permanent Magnets on the Torque Ripple of Surface Mounted Permanent Magnet Motors
publicationTitle: 2022 2nd International Conference on Consumer Electronics and Computer Engineering (ICCECE)
abstract: With the improvement of energy saving and emission reduction requirements, the performance requirements of permanent magnet motors are getting higher and higher. Reducing torque ripple is an unavoidable problem for permanent magnet motors. Normally, the permanent magnets of permanent magnet motors are used in the axial direction. Permanent magnets of the same shape. In order to reduce torque pulsation, adopt different pole arc coefficients (Embrace), eccentricity (Offset) and pole width (pole width) combined magnetic poles in the axial direction of permanent magnet motors. The parametric simulation module uses the zooming algorithm to find the optimal combination, and finally achieves the goal of reducing torque ripple. The simulation results show that the optimization method can significantly reduce torque ripple.

articleTitle: A Fast CU Depth Decision Algorithm Based on Moving Object Detection for High Efficiency Video Coding
publicationTitle: 2022 2nd International Conference on Consumer Electronics and Computer Engineering (ICCECE)
abstract: Compared with Advanced Video Coding (AVC), High Efficiency Video Coding (HEVC) standard has higher compression ratio under the same reconstructed video quality. The improvement of coding ability depends on the introduction of many new coding technologies, such as flexible quadtree structure and more prediction modes. However, these coding tools also bring great computational complexity, which brings challenges to the real-time application of HEVC. Therefore, reducing the computational complexity of HEVC is a very meaningful topic. In this paper, firstly, we use Binary Sum of Absolute Difference (BSAD) to divide Coding Tree Unit (CTU) into three different types, namely static region, moving object boundary and moving object interior. Then, we utilize the depth distribution characteristics of different types to predict the depth range of Coding Tree Unit (CTU). Experimental results show that the proposed algorithm can effectively avoid unnecessary depth traversal, save 48.75% of coding time on average, and only increase the bitrate by 0.98%.

articleTitle: Research on path planning of UAV based on Hybrid A* algorithm
publicationTitle: 2022 2nd International Conference on Consumer Electronics and Computer Engineering (ICCECE)
abstract: UAVs are widely used in fields such as industrial inspection, disaster relief and package transportation. Therefore, it has great significance to realize safe and smooth path planning in an unknown dynamic environment. For this reason, this paper designs a path planning system suitable for unknown environment based on the hybrid A<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">*</sup> algorithm by the following three modules, the planning module, the navigation module and the control module to achieve the above-mentioned functions. We built a drone model and experimental environment in the gazebo simulator, verified the performance of the system with smoothness as an indicator.

articleTitle: Location and identification of suspension insulators based on RRPN
publicationTitle: 2022 2nd International Conference on Consumer Electronics and Computer Engineering (ICCECE)
abstract: In order to improve the refinement of insulator detection, a suspension insulator location and identification method based on RRPN is proposed in this paper. The RRPN algorithm is used to extract and train the image data of suspension insulator, and the positioning recognition based on inclined box is realized. This paper compares the training curves of the model under different learning rates and selects the optimal learning rate. The average accuracy of the optimal model was 88.47%. The results show that the method proposed in this paper can be combined with the application scenario of suspension insulator UV diagnosis to reduce false detection. The model shows strong robustness in the case of occlusion and truncation and has certain academic innovation and engineering application value.

articleTitle: Integrated access control monitoring system based on face video detection
publicationTitle: 2022 2nd International Conference on Consumer Electronics and Computer Engineering (ICCECE)
abstract: In order to realize the integrated entrance guard detection in the scene of random flow of people.combined with face recognition algorithm, the design method of integrated entrance guard monitoring system is proposed based on face video detection. A face video feature detection model in the scene of random flow of people is established, block matching on the face video features in the scene of random flow of people is performed, a living feature analysis model of face video monitoring in the scene of random flow of people is established by adopting the method of block feature information fusion, the face feature recognition and information fusion is realized by adopting the method of biological directional recognition, and the statistical features and edge detail parameters of face video in the scene of random flow of people are extracted, Combined with the face anti-deception algorithm, the authenticity of the face in the process of integrated entrance guard monitoring is judged. On the basis of dynamic biometric detection, the feature recognition of facial expressions under different expressions such as nature, smile and mouth opening are realized, and the integrated entrance guard monitoring is realized according to the feature recognition results. In the embedded and cloud technology environment, the alarm controller of integrated access control is built to realize access control, information privacy protection, image recognition and information playback, and the system hardware design is realized. The simulation results show that the designed integrated entrance guard monitoring system has high detection and recognition ability of face features and good recognition accuracy.

articleTitle: Three-Dimension Visualization of Environmental Scalar Data Based on GeoSOT-3D Grids
publicationTitle: 2022 2nd International Conference on Consumer Electronics and Computer Engineering (ICCECE)
abstract: Given the rich data types and large data volume of environmental scalar data, a three-dimensional environment visualization system based on GeoSOT-3D subdivision grids is proposed. A complete set of data services based on the ClickHouse database and gRPC framework was built as backstage support to manage and transmit the queried environment data. At the same time, the three-dimensional visualization of the environmental field on a virtual earth is achieved by using the ray casting method. This work provides a technical route to efficiently organize and rapidly display environmental data of various granularity on a global scale, laying a foundation for further spatial analysis of environmental field.

articleTitle: Detection and localization of sound events based on principal components analysis
publicationTitle: 2022 2nd International Conference on Consumer Electronics and Computer Engineering (ICCECE)
abstract: In order to improve the accuracy of sound source localization based on depth learning and reduce the amount of model calculation. In this paper, a principal component analysis sound event localization and detection network (PCA-SELDnet) based on convolution recurrent network model (SELDnet) is proposed, which introduces time domain feature weighted phase transition generalized cross-correlation (GCC-PHAT) and uses principal component analysis (PCA) carries out dimensionality reduction and reconstruction, obtains the features of several dimensions with large contribution, and then combines them with the amplitude spectrum of the original spectrogram for input. The combined features are mapped into two output matrices through SELDnet model, one output is sound event detection matrix and the other output is sound source localization matrix. The results show that PCA-SELDnet improves the accuracy of sound event localization.

articleTitle: Product Requirement Information Using TF-IDF and Naive Bayes Techniques as a Remedy for Stakeholders in IT-Enterprises
publicationTitle: 2022 2nd International Conference on Consumer Electronics and Computer Engineering (ICCECE)
abstract: Writing adequate requirements necessitates a delicate sensibility on the researcher's part. It is not uncommon for requirements to go through numerous iterations before all stakeholders understand them. In this research study, unspecified requirements are detected as incomplete written functional and non-functional requirements and analyzed using a specification matrix. The matrix presents a new metric for assessing whether requirements are fully specified, moderately specified, or unspecified. The specification matrix is put through a UseCase within Deutsche Telekom (DT) AG. The unspecified requirements are subjected to a semantic review using a requirements stencil, referred to as adequate product requirement information (PRI). The adequate PRI are automatically classified by categories, including chapters, using statistical approaches (TF-IDF and Naive Bayes probability calculation). To avoid the propagation of unspecified requirements, this work seeks to evaluate stakeholder-oriented novel solutions utilizing the specification matrix and the TF-IDF with the Naive Bayes probability computation.

articleTitle: Coal Gangue Data Set Expansion Method Based on DCGAN
publicationTitle: 2022 2nd International Conference on Consumer Electronics and Computer Engineering (ICCECE)
abstract: Coal gangue separation is one of the important links in the process of coal mining. High gangue content will lead to low combustion efficiency of power plants and serious environmental pollution. Through field investigation and investigation, it is found that at present, most mines still use manual gangue separation. The dust in the coal preparation bunker is large and the light is dark. Long-term and high load work will not only harm the health of workers, It will also affect the sorting efficiency. Based on this, this paper proposes a deep learning target detection algorithm to replace manual gangue selection, but the target detection algorithm depends on a large number of coal and gangue images for training to achieve better robustness. In order to overcome the problem of small number of data sets and poor quality in the automatic sorting of coal gangue based on deep learning methods, the paper proposes an image expansion method based on Deep Convolutional Generative Adversarial Networks(DCGAN),which adds a feature fusion part to the generator network It is used to improve the diversity of the output image, and at the same time, the loss function is improved to Wasserstein distance to overcome the problem of the disappearance of the generator gradient. The experimental results show that the images generated by the improved DCGAN network have good performance in diversity and quality. The images generated by the improved DCGAN network increase the accuracy of coal gangue recognition by 5.87%.

articleTitle: Research on the detection of COVID-19 via X-ray images based on triplet network under the condition of scarce data
publicationTitle: 2022 2nd International Conference on Consumer Electronics and Computer Engineering (ICCECE)
abstract: With the outbreak of Omicron continuing to spread internationally, there is an urgent need to seek a prompt, effective and precise method to screen patients for infection. It was found in early studies that abnormal chest radiograph proves the vital evidence to confirm a patient infected with COVID-19 or not. Therefore, deep neural network (DNN) model trained with various and sufficient chest radiographs has become an alternative for medical screening and clinical diagnosis. The effectiveness of DNN is principally determined by the scale of chest X-ray images rather than other factors. Significantly, the more scarce training set becomes, the worse DNN will perform. In this paper, Triplet network derived from metric learning is applied to tackle the problem of scarce medical data. Using different Triplet loss functions to optimize the VGG-16 model pre-trained on ImageNet, our model enables to screen patients infected COVID-19 and distinguish normal, pneumonia and COVID-19 chest medical images rapidly, efficiently and accurately in spite of scarce data. With 91.5% accuracy in TriHard loss model and 92.4% accuracy Triplet-center loss model achieved, these all prove better result than base model.

articleTitle: Large-scale heterogeneous terminal management technology for power Internet of Things platform
publicationTitle: 2022 2nd International Conference on Consumer Electronics and Computer Engineering (ICCECE)
abstract: This paper studies the large-scale management, large-concurrency, and high-reliability of the Internet of Things platform for heterogeneous terminals in the power grid. It sorts out the management framework of different intelligent terminals, intelligent gateways and other heterogeneous terminal equipment in professional fields such as power transmission, power transformation, and distribution, and relies on flexible expansion. Strategies and technologies to meet the management needs of the Internet of Things platform for large-scale terminals; study the container management technology of smart terminals and smart gateways based on the Internet of Things platform, and propose the Internet of Things for the information collection and equipment management requirements of smart terminals and smart gateways by containers. The management technology of micro-applications between the platform and smart terminals and smart gateway containers; research the OTA operation and maintenance service capabilities such as terminal file distribution, terminal file encryption, and terminal update plan release of the Internet of Things platform, and realize the remote upgrade of smart terminal and smart gateway device software.

articleTitle: Time Delay Compensation Strategy of Networked Control System Based on CS-BP and IGPC
publicationTitle: 2022 2nd International Conference on Consumer Electronics and Computer Engineering (ICCECE)
abstract: Aiming at a class of networked control systems with time delay, this paper proposes an implicit generalized predictive control algorithm based on cuckoo-optimized BP neural network. Firstly, BP neural network is used to predict the future time delay and the BP neural network is continuously adjusted through the cuckoo algorithm to improve the prediction accuracy and the optimal weight threshold is obtained to avoid the BP neural network from falling into the local optimum. Then, implicit generalized predictive control is used to identify system parameters based on input and output, thereby reducing the amount of calculation. The predicted delay is substituted into the implicit generalized predictive control as the actual value of the future delay to compensate the delay. The simulation results show that the predictive output tracking reference effect of this method is better. Compared with self-tuning PID and IGPC, it has good signal tracking ability, can effectively complete the delay compensation and has more practical value.

articleTitle: Human Resource Recommendation Based on Recurrent Convolutional Neural Network
publicationTitle: 2022 2nd International Conference on Consumer Electronics and Computer Engineering (ICCECE)
abstract: In recent years, with the rapid development of network technology, network recruitment has become the main channel for HR recruitment with the advantage of low cost. However, in the face of widely varying job requirements, it is very time-consuming and laborious for recruiters to find matching talents among a large number of resumes. In order to reduce the difficulty of screening and improve the efficiency of screening, this paper proposes a recurrent convolutional neural network-based model to process complex textual information of resumes and texts. That is, a neural network based on Bi-directional Long Short term Memory (BiLSTM) and Convolutional Neural Network (CNN) to extract word-level features of job requirements and resume text, and Attention mechanism is used to measure the importance of job requirements to different work experiences and the contribution of work experiences to different job requirements, which can effectively match job requirements and resume text information through the combination of the three.

articleTitle: Research on Intrusion Detection Based on Neural Network Optimized by Genetic Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2022 2nd International Conference on Consumer Electronics and Computer Engineering (ICCECE)
abstract: With the development of 5G and the emergence of the COVID-19 epidemic, network traffic has surged, and network security has once again become a key concern. Intrusion detection system is an important means to protect network security. It can find abnormal conditions in the early stage of cyber attack. Intrusion detection is also a kind of abnormal detection in a broad sense. To improve the performance of the intrusion detection system, a cyber-attack detection method combining Borderline SMOTE and improved BP neural network (Back-Propagation neural network) is proposed. It mainly uses one-hot encoding, Borderline SMOTE data oversampling and other technologies to preprocess the data, and uses the BP neural network improved by genetic algorithm to predict cyber attacks. Finally, the model is compared with other traditional machine learning models through the core indicator recall and auxiliary indicators precision, roc curve, etc. The results show that the hybrid detection model proposed in this study has higher recall and lower running time, and performs better in intrusion detection.

articleTitle: Research on Improved FP-Tree Algorithm Based on Hadoop
publicationTitle: 2022 2nd International Conference on Consumer Electronics and Computer Engineering (ICCECE)
abstract: With the development of science and technology, the Internet is more and more widely used in all aspects of society, and the research on the combination of data mining and big data platform has gradually become an urgent demand. This paper studies the association rules algorithm based on FP- Tree algorithm, and proposes the improvement of the algorithm. After combining with Hadoop platform, the algorithm is implemented and tested in big data environment, and the efficiency of the algorithm is improved to some extent.

articleTitle: Experimental study on Plosives of Tibetan Labrang Dialect Based on Computer Technology
publicationTitle: 2022 2nd International Conference on Consumer Electronics and Computer Engineering (ICCECE)
abstract: The deep integration of information technology and national education is not only an effective way to realize the leap-forward development of national education, but also an inevitable requirement to realize the maximization of the value of educational informationization, which profoundly affects the overall strategy of promoting the modernization of education in China. In view of this, with the help of computer technology and experimental phonetics, this paper mainly extracted two important parameters of the acoustic characteristics of the plosive in Labrang Dialect, namely, the occluding segment (GAP) and the voice start time (VOT), drew the acoustic pattern of the plosives, and analyzed the characteristics of the plosive in Labrang Dialect. Through the experimental research, we find that,the six voiceless plosives of Labrang dialect are divided into two regions: unaspirated voiceless plosives (including [p], [t], [k]) and aspirated voiceless plosives (including [ph], [th], [kh]), which are distributed in the upper left and lower right of the pattern diagram respectively. At the same time, there is a significant difference in the [ph] of male and female vocalist from the pattern diagrams. The [ph] of male vocalists occupies a higher position in the voiceless region and is located near the vertical axis of the upper left side, while the [ph] of female vocalists occupies the lowest position in the voiceless region and is slightly near the lower right side. This paper has important linguistic reference value for Tibetan speech synthesis technology and natural language processing.

articleTitle: Research and Implementation of SVPWM Control Strategy for Centrifugal Actuator
publicationTitle: 2022 2nd International Conference on Consumer Electronics and Computer Engineering (ICCECE)
abstract: In this paper, a permanent magnet brushless DC motor drive centrifugal actuator system is selected as the execution component of the helicopter structure response active control system (ACSR). By adjusting the rotation phase difference, phase and speed of the eccentric wheel drive motors of the two actuators, the output force amplitude, phase and frequency of the actuator are controlled, based on which the mathematical and control model of the output force of the centrifugal actuator is constructed. In order to improve the control accuracy and response speed of the speed loop, a new space vector PWM control algorithm with synchronization signal is proposed. It divides a time period into fixed time slices and each voltage vector in each time slice is calculated offline. The action time of the system is driven by looking up the table, which greatly reduces the complexity of the modulation, reduces the software execution time of the modulation strategy, is conducive to the high-frequency operation of the system, and reduces the switching loss of the inverter. To verify the effect of active vibration suppression, a set of eccentric wheels is rotated as the source of vibration to simulate the vibration caused by the helicopter rotor system, while the other set of eccentric wheels is used as the source of active vibration suppression, being subject to the opposite phase as well as reaction forces with the same frequency and the same amplitude, which verifies Strength, verified the feasibility of the control strategy.

articleTitle: Research on cloud-side collaborative task migration strategy based on simulated annealing-Bee Colony Algorithm in Power IoT
publicationTitle: 2022 2nd International Conference on Consumer Electronics and Computer Engineering (ICCECE)
abstract: In the power IoT, in order to make up for the shortcomings of insufficient computing capabilities of edge-side devices, cloud-side collaboration technology has attracted more and more attention. The cloud-side collaboration technology relies on the selection of task migration strategies. However, when the existing migration strategies face the complex edge-side terminal devices in the power IoT, the energy consumption and delay performance are not good enough, which greatly affects the user's power experience. Therefore, it is very valuable to study a cloud-side collaborative task migration strategy under the power IoT environment. This paper proposes a task migration strategy based on simulated annealing-Bee Colony Algorithm in the environment of power IoT, which can solve the problem of task migration. Experimental results show that compared with the existing popular methods, this method has advantages in terms of energy consumption and time delay. This research can meet the real-time requirements of the power IoT, while reducing energy consumption and improving the user's power experience, thereby promoting the further development of the power IoT.

articleTitle: Potential purchase intention capturing method based on consumer's interests mining in social networks
publicationTitle: 2022 2nd International Conference on Consumer Electronics and Computer Engineering (ICCECE)
abstract: Traditional session-based recommendation systems usually capture users' potential purchase intention from their recent transaction records, which does not consider the impact of social networks on users' interests. This paper proposes a new method by mining consumption information in social networks. First of all, a novel method based on a recurrent neural network is designed to express the correlation between users' purchasing behaviors, which dynamically captures users' interests in different scenarios. Secondly, to more accurately obtain the interests of neighbor nodes in social networks, this paper designs a multi-layer recurrent neural network with residual structure, which enriches the consumption information of neighbor nodes, and at the same time allows the original feature information of nodes to be retained during the propagation process of the deep network. Finally, the two interests are merged into users' potential purchase intention, which improves the performance of recommendation systems. The experimental results prove the effectiveness of the two methods proposed in this paper. Their Recall and Normalized Discounted Cumulative Gain on Douban Movie and Delicious datasets both outperform the state-of-art models.

articleTitle: Detection of fungal infection in apple using reconstructed reflectance spectra
publicationTitle: 2022 2nd International Conference on Consumer Electronics and Computer Engineering (ICCECE)
abstract: In this study, a detection method of fungal infection in apple is proposed using reconstructed reflectance spectra. The reconstructed spectra were transformed from RGB images by Wiener estimation (WEN). Logistic regression (LR), gradient boosting decision tree (GBDT), classification and regression tree (CART) were adopted to classify healthy fruits and Botrytis cinerea infected fruits combining with the obtained spectra. The optimal classification was gotten with an accuracy of 96.67%, and reconstruction from RGB is low-cost. Thus, the proposed method can detect apple infection accurately and quickly with high practical value.

articleTitle: Using Handle system to provide persistent identifiers for diploma
publicationTitle: 2022 2nd International Conference on Consumer Electronics and Computer Engineering (ICCECE)
abstract: One of the essential factors for recruiters in a selection process is study background. It is, therefore, crucial to verify the authenticity of diplomas. Currently, it's easy to make a fake diploma with some software. Some websites can also generate one in a few minutes. You just need to give your information and pay some money. Between lies on the resume, fake documents, buying diplomas, producing real fake certificates, recruiters have a hard time dealing with candidates who come forward. This paper proposes to combine the handle system with blockchain technology to avoid this scourge. The handle system will provide to each diploma delivered by an institution a persistent identifier and will use blockchain technology to store and secure the data. The system will give all graduated students a unique identifier to check quickly and indefinitely their diplomas and grades.

articleTitle: Application of Neural Network in Pixel Art Creation: Bi-directional Conversion between Photo and Pixel Art with GAN Base Model
publicationTitle: 2022 2nd International Conference on Consumer Electronics and Computer Engineering (ICCECE)
abstract: Pixel art was first developed in the last century when computers have limited memory and processing power, and is in wide use in the game industry now. However, pixel art is a highly stylized art form that requires skilled human artists to create and the creation process is time consuming. This paper proposes an automatic way to convert photos to pixel drawings and the reverse with unsupervised, GAN based neural networks.

articleTitle: Research on BP network modeling of solar heat pump hot water system
publicationTitle: 2022 2nd International Conference on Consumer Electronics and Computer Engineering (ICCECE)
abstract: The model of the heat pump running time and COP(ratio of rated heatingcapacity to rated power consumption) of the parallel solar-assisted heat pump water heater system was analyzed through numerical simulation and experimental research. The network model based on BP neural network was established. The results show the established model has a high accuracy, which provides a meaningful way to the fullest use of solar energy as much as possible and has minimal electric power consumption as little as possible. Statistical analysis shows that the proposed model is accurate and effective.

articleTitle: Information-theoretic feature selection based on the Weight of the New Classification Information
publicationTitle: 2022 2nd International Conference on Consumer Electronics and Computer Engineering (ICCECE)
abstract: Many objective functions of feature selection methods are positively correlated with the amount of the new classification information and negatively correlated with the amount of redundant information. However, a critical issue in these methods is they ignore the magnitude of the negative correlation of redundant information. So, we proposed a new method from another perspective to measure redundancy between features, and employ the Weight of the New Classification Information (WNCI) to ensure features are related with class label when selected feature is given. Finally, we tested the classification accuracy of the proposed method and compared with five other methods on eighteen data sets. Then the experiment results show that the new proposed method performs better than these other methods in terms of classification accuracy.

articleTitle: Chinese poetry generation model with UniLM
publicationTitle: 2022 2nd International Conference on Consumer Electronics and Computer Engineering (ICCECE)
abstract: Many existing Chinese poetry generation models are based on Recurrent Neural Network Language Model. The Chinese poetry generated by these methods have serious defects in rhythm and fluency. A method of using Unfied Language Model Pre-training for Natural Language Understanding and Generation(UniLM) to generate Chinese poetry is proposed. The model is based on Transformer network. UniLM not only has the same good natural language understanding ability as BERT, but also has the ability of natural language generation. It is a pre-training language model that can generate and understand. This paper uses UniLM to realize the automatic generation of Chinese poetry, through the experiment on Chinese poetry data set, it can show that the Chinese poetry generation method based on UniLM is better than the proposed ones. It has significantly improve in fluency, rhythm and poetry.

articleTitle: Migration node selection strategy based on gray prediction algorithm in trusted environment
publicationTitle: 2022 2nd International Conference on Consumer Electronics and Computer Engineering (ICCECE)
abstract: This paper studies the selection strategy of task migration nodes. Considering the security of nodes, this paper analyzes the trusted security model of each node of migration candidates. Security credibility includes three aspects: time credibility, behavior credibility and resource credibility. By calculating the trusted values of migration nodes in these three aspects, Three nodes with the lowest trust value are obtained to preliminarily screen the migration nodes, and the final nodes are determined in the remaining nodes. Because the gray prediction algorithm requires a small number of original data models and has a strong discrete type, it is more suitable for the model selected by the task migration nodes. This paper uses the gray prediction algorithm to finally determine the migration nodes, In the experiment, the cloud simulation platform is used to compare the algorithm and random algorithm, and the results show the effectiveness of the algorithm.

articleTitle: Target Tracking Method based on Reinforcement Learning
publicationTitle: 2022 2nd International Conference on Consumer Electronics and Computer Engineering (ICCECE)
abstract: In recent years, target tracking has become a hot topic in the field of computer vision. Many tracking algorithms based on deep learning have been proposed, but some of them have a large amount of computation or do not perform well in the face of target deformation and loss. The combination of reinforcement learning and deep learning is used and the actor critical framework is introduced, the target tracking task has been solved to a certain extent in the above problems. By improving the existing target tracking algorithm based on reinforcement learning, we can make it better adapt to complex scenes and target deformation, we test on OTB-100 dataset and have some improvement over the improved algorithm, Our method has better effect on OTB-100 dataset than the improved algorithm.

articleTitle: Intelligent temperature control of large volume concrete
publicationTitle: 2022 2nd International Conference on Consumer Electronics and Computer Engineering (ICCECE)
abstract: the era of “Internet of Things, Big Data and Cloud Computing”, artificial intelligence is applied to the construction of large volume concrete projects to establish a multi-disciplinary and multi-technology intelligent control system, with temperature control as the core and stress control in a safe range. The intelligent control system uses high-precision sensors as the sensing medium and machine learning as the core analysis and decision-making. Based on the core data of concrete temperature, stress and strain sensed by the sensors, the data processing methods are improved by empirical algorithms to analyse the concrete performance, enabling the control system to be adjusted autonomously in different environmental contexts, making rational decisions and automatically adjusting the “engineering input values” to ensure high quality construction.

articleTitle: Monopulse Imaging Technology Based on Super-resolution in Doppler Domain
publicationTitle: 2022 2nd International Conference on Consumer Electronics and Computer Engineering (ICCECE)
abstract: Monopulse angle measuring technology combined with scanning radar can effectively solve the problem of blind area in forward-looking radar imaging. However, it fails to work when multiple targets exist in the same beamwidth, resulting in the degradation of imaging quality. Aiming at this problem, monopulse imaging technology based on super-resolution in Doppler domain is proposed in this paper, which utilizes Doppler gradient differences caused by relative movement between targets and radar platform to separate targets in different azimuth. Conventional fast Fourier transform (FFT) method is adopted to convert the signal into the Doppler domain, but it suffers from low resolution and high sidelobes. Thus, an iterative adaptive estimation method based on minimum mean square error (MMSE) is proposed to suppress sidelobes in Doppler domain, achieving the preliminary separation. Then, monopulse angle measuring technology based on sum to difference ratio in Doppler domain is applied to complete the energy projection, achieving secondary separation. The simulation results verify the effectiveness of the proposed algorithm in improving azimuth resolution.

articleTitle: A Lightweight SAR Image Recognition Algorithm Based On Deep Convolutional Neural Network
publicationTitle: 2022 2nd International Conference on Consumer Electronics and Computer Engineering (ICCECE)
abstract: Synthetic Aperture Radar (SAR) can provide large-scale, all-time, all-weather imaging and therefore plays an important role in both military reconnaissance and battlefield perception. In recent years, due to the outstanding performance of deep convolutional neural networks (CNNs) on image recognition, the approaches that apply CNNs to SAR target recognition has attracted widespread attention among domestic and foreign scholars. The CNNs can achieve high accuracy, yet they often contain huge number of parameters and occupy too much memory to be deployed on devices with memory constraint. In this work, we build light-weight SAR image recognition models by performing iterative pruning and retraining on three representative architectures. The algorithm can lead to a 50% reduction in the number of parameters, while still obtaining a high accuracy of 98.5%. Our algorithm and results provide a potential direction for building light-weight SAR image model that can be deployed for real-world applications.

articleTitle: Detection of Interleukin-6 in the Serum of Uremia Patients Based on Fluorescence Image
publicationTitle: 2022 2nd International Conference on Consumer Electronics and Computer Engineering (ICCECE)
abstract: Enzyme-linked immunosorbent assay (ELISA) is widely used in drug development, disease diagnosis and other fields. Here we report a protein detection method that combines fluorescent-encoded micromagnetic beads and micro holes array technology, which can specifically detect the content of interleukin-6 (IL-6) at the level of pg/mL. In the experiment, permanent magnet was used to increase the falling hole rate of magnetic beads to improve the detection accuracy of digital ELISA, and used COMSOL software to simulate the magnetic field density. The capture magnetic beads combine with IL-6 and the enzyme-labeled complex to form a sandwich structure. The magnetic beads specifically bound to the enzyme label can catalyze the fluorescent substrate to produce fluorescent substances. Then use the image processing program to analyze the fluorescence intensity. The levels of IL-6 in the serum of 12 uremic patients before and after hemodialysis and 10 controls were successfully detected.

articleTitle: Research on Knowledge Map of China Industrial Internet Industry Based on CNKI
publicationTitle: 2022 2nd International Conference on Consumer Electronics and Computer Engineering (ICCECE)
abstract: The research on knowledge map of industrial Internet industry can not only predict the development direction and trend of China's industrial Internet, but also provide scientific reference for the sustainable development strategy of China's Internet. CiteSpace software is used to analyze the scientific knowledge map of key documents in relevant journals and various types of maps constructed in the development of industrial Internet industry. The evolution path and main influencing factors of hot spots in different stages are analyzed. Through various types of maps, it can be concluded that China's industrial Internet has changed from the initial conceptual model to the practice and innovation model in the past decade, and has gradually improved its economic status in China, which has become the main driving force of China's economy. Finally, this paper gives reasonable suggestions on the development trend of Internet. The data in this paper are selected from CNKI database, which has certain limitations. The next step can be to use a more comprehensive database or focus on substantive research such as patents.

articleTitle: A Method for Establishing Communication Network with Low Cost and High Stability
publicationTitle: 2022 2nd International Conference on Consumer Electronics and Computer Engineering (ICCECE)
abstract: The Hamiltonian cycle in graph theory is helpful to deal with the stability problem in network communication. However, how to balance the comprehensive cost and communication reliability in network communication is an unresolved issue. This paper proposes a new reliability network algorithm. This method comprehensively compares cost factors and stability factors, and provides a more effective solution for constructing low-cost and high-reliability network communications. Through comparative analysis with graph theory algorithms and heuristic learning algorithms, and tests on actual network communication problems, it is finally verified that the method proposed in this paper is more reasonable, effective, stable and feasible than previous methods.

articleTitle: Vehicle Color Recognition Algorithm Based on Color Space and Sector Features and Related Laws and Regulations
publicationTitle: 2022 2nd International Conference on Consumer Electronics and Computer Engineering (ICCECE)
abstract: In this paper, a vehicle color recognition algorithm combined with color space and sector features is designed. With the increasing number of vehicles and the complex traffic environment, vehicle recognition by license plate can no longer meet people's needs. The information of vehicle color which can make up for the deficiency of license plate recognition caused by vehicle deck and multiple license plates is more likely to attract people's interest. Vehicle color recognition is of great significance to identify, search, improve and enhance the function of intelligent transportation system. This paper presents a simple and effective vehicle color recognition algorithm combining color space and sector features. Experiments show that the algorithm can accurately recognize vehicle color on embedded devices in real-time.

articleTitle: University intelligent teaching evaluation management system based on 5G environment
publicationTitle: 2022 2nd International Conference on Consumer Electronics and Computer Engineering (ICCECE)
abstract: As the Internet goes deeper and deeper into colleges and universities, the digital construction of the new era of colleges and universities is particularly important, especially the graduation design of college students to test the quality of learning is the most important. Therefore, under the catalysis of information technology, most schools have given up the traditional way of teaching evaluation, put the teaching quality evaluation on the platform, and use the intelligent classroom teaching evaluation management system. Intelligent classroom teaching evaluation management system is a management software developed for the school's teaching administrators, students and teachers to evaluate and manage teaching quality. Administrators act as educational administrators in reality, can achieve student management, teacher management, curriculum management, evaluation statistics summary and analysis and other functions. Students can evaluate the teachers in their own courses. Teachers can evaluate the peers through lectures, can also view the current course under which students haven't evaluation, have the effect of supervise the students, as well as the evaluation results, the summary of the peers in the students and teachers of every evaluation index score, and feedback, teachers get the feedback information, also can better improve their own teaching plan. Teaching supervision can check the teaching quality evaluation of the whole school, check the specific evaluation of each person on the course, and effectively supervise the teaching quality of teachers.

articleTitle: A Tabnet based Card Fraud detetion Algorithm with Feature Engineering
publicationTitle: 2022 2nd International Conference on Consumer Electronics and Computer Engineering (ICCECE)
abstract: With the development of technology, there are some inventions has been raised, such as credit cards for paying in electronic transaction. People can trade in a short time with credit cards. However, it will be a double-edged sword because it provided a chance for criminals, and in turn, increased fraud rate. Therefore, there is an urgent need for researchers to research and proposed some methods. In our article, we utilize TabNet as our model. The dataset is provided by IEEE-CIS and it contains many transaction records and whether the transaction is fraud. In the feature engineering process, we compress the datasets and fill the missing value with -999. In the training process, the cross validation has been used, we split the dataset into 5 folds, and train them one by one. And we do some improvement to compress the memory. Finally, to evaluate how well TabNet performed, we compare it with other classical models: Naïve Bayes and XGBOOST. The result shows that our model has the best performance using the metrics ----accuracy and AUC-ROC score among these models. It is obvious that TabNet owns the highest AUC-ROC score and accuracy, and they are 0.884 and 0.965 respectively. In the future, we can improve the model and data based on this information to improve the classification effect and apply the model to other fraud detection problems.

articleTitle: Study on self-intersection detection algorithm based on OBJ model
publicationTitle: 2022 2nd International Conference on Consumer Electronics and Computer Engineering (ICCECE)
abstract: In order to solve the problem of “Clipping” in the animation production process, that is, the self-intersection of the model, this paper proposes a model self-intersection detection algorithm based on the ray method. This method is aimed at the OBJ file format and can render and display the self-intersection detection results. The algorithm has high computational efficiency and accurate results, which can realize rapid evaluation of complex models. This research not only has practical value for common 3D animation production, but also has important significance for the application of deep learning to realize the related research in the field of complex 3D model reconstruction.

articleTitle: NUIM: An Algorithm for Maximizing the Influence of Information Diffusion on Dynamic Social Networks
publicationTitle: 2022 2nd International Conference on Consumer Electronics and Computer Engineering (ICCECE)
abstract: In recent years, the problem of maximizing influence has been an important topic in social network research, but existing methods usually ignore the subjective willingness of selected seed nodes and the uncertainty of the probability of propagation, which leads to deviations of marketing results from the plan. This paper proposes a dynamic social network information diffusion influence maximization algorithm NUIM. First, the historical data is used to estimate the probability that the selected seed node is willing to become a seed, and a new propagation probability function Φ is further designed to make the information propagation probability follow the distribution related to the network topology instead of a fixed value. Secondly, to enable the agent to learn the optimal seed node selection strategy, the cyclic learning rate is used to replace the artificially set initial value of the learning rate and the learning rate decay strategy in reinforcement learning. The experimental results show that on the power-law network data set, the influence rate obtained by NUIM can reach 16.43%, which is better than other algorithms with better performance.

articleTitle: Querying scheme of tobacco traceability information based on double-blockchain structure
publicationTitle: 2022 2nd International Conference on Consumer Electronics and Computer Engineering (ICCECE)
abstract: In this paper, a double-blockchain structure based on “public blockchain + consortium blockchain” was proposed for the information querying of tobacco traceability system. The public blockchain adopts Ethereum platform, which can not only ensure the openness of data but also ensure data security. The consortium blockchain adopts Hyperledger Fabric platform, and only internal organizations of tobacco companies participate in setting certain permissions for tobacco companies. In addition, we also improve the consensus mechanism of the consortium blockchain and add management node to ensure the security of the consortium blockchain. The double-blockchain structure proposed in this paper can not only improve the security of querying tobacco traceability information but also not affect the efficiency of querying.

articleTitle: Preparation of MgF2, SiO2 and TiO2 Optical Films
publicationTitle: 2022 2nd International Conference on Consumer Electronics and Computer Engineering (ICCECE)
abstract: In order to improve the light reception on the surface of optical elements, the electron-beam evaporation method was used to prepare the transparency-enhancing films. The simulated one-layer, three-layer and six-layer transmission-enhancing film systems of MgF2, SiO2 and TiO2 were simulated using Macleod optical thin film design software, and the six-layer transmission-enhancing films of MgF2 and TiO2 superimposed were optimally designed using the simplex method. The films were prepared with different parameters using a ZZS800-3/G chamber vacuum coater. The results show that the single-layer films of MgF2 have the highest transmittance on glass substrates, the single-layer and three-layer films have good transmittance in specific wavelength bands, the six-layer films have high transmittance in the visible wavelength band from 400 to 700 nm, and the best transmittance is achieved when the incident light angle is varied from 0 to 60°. Among the different preparation processes, the film with the smallest electron beam flow and the slowest evaporation rate has the best optical performance, and the average transmittance of the six-layer film is 95.0%, with the maximum value of 95.3% at 510 nm and 700 nm.

articleTitle: DPRL: Labeling Relation Based on Distant Supervision and POS Rule
publicationTitle: 2022 2nd International Conference on Consumer Electronics and Computer Engineering (ICCECE)
abstract: The lack of high-quality labeled data is one of the main challenges to a lot of relation extraction tasks. Distant supervision introduces many noises, while labeling data manually is costly. In this paper, we design a novel labeling rule called the POS rule. POS rule improves the precision of relation extraction by considering the position, ontology, and semantic of relations. We propose a POS rule mining and optimization framework to generate high-quality labeled data. Experiments on real datasets show that the proposed discovery algorithms can find high-quality POS rules which accurately label training data for relation extraction.

articleTitle: An Adversarial Attack Algorithm based on Edge-Sketched Feature from Latent Space
publicationTitle: 2022 2nd International Conference on Consumer Electronics and Computer Engineering (ICCECE)
abstract: Adversarial examples are specially designed examples which mislead deep learning models but could be correctly classified by human. They are usually generated by multiple iterations on the input according to the aim of increasing the classification loss. However, such approaches show slow training speed and unstable transferability. In this paper, we propose a latent space feature based adversarial attack algorithm, named as LSFAA, to address these technical challenges. LSFAA uses an Adversarial Feature Extraction Network to extract from inputs' latent space and utilizes these maps as adversarial perturbations. Thus the iterations are conducted on the parameters of the extraction network instead of the input. Therefore, the trained network is able to be used as a generator and mass generate adversarial examples without consuming too much time. Furthermore, an edge-sketched perturbation additional method is proposed to achieve imperceptible visualization. Inspired by convolutional neural network's characteristic of extracting edge information for further identification, we add the generated perturbation only on the chosen edge area of the input. Such method reaches a balance between attack ability and imperceptible visualization. Experimental results demonstrate that LSFAA achieves an average attack success rate of 99.21 % on four commonly used deep learning models.

articleTitle: Construction of the Convolutional neural network Based on the increase optimizers provided and atomic layers provided
publicationTitle: 2022 2nd International Conference on Consumer Electronics and Computer Engineering (ICCECE)
abstract: In order to solve the problem of low accuracy of traditional neural network code test set and verification set, we use VGG network structure to deal with it. Its main feature is that it has a simple structure and replaces all convolution kernels with 3 × 3. Compared with the pooled cores of Alexnet, VGG uses 2 × 2 pooled cores. Number of parameters is large, and most of the parameters are concentrated in the full connection layer. Proper network initialization and use of batch normalization layer are very important for training deep network. In Alexnet, there is only one convolution in each convolution layer, and the convolution kernel is 7*7. In VGGnet, each convolution layer contains 2 ~4 convolution operations. The most obvious improvement of VGGnet is to reduce the size of convolution kernel and increase the number of convolution layers. Based on the traditional convolutional neural network, we train a better classifier to realize the recognition and classification of cifar-10 data sets. The accuracy of verification set is improved from 52.9% to 70.3%, and the accuracy of test set is improved from 54.7% to 71.5%.

articleTitle: Analysis on Data of Galloping and Wind Deviation Sensors in Eastern Mongolia during the Winter of 2021
publicationTitle: 2022 2nd International Conference on Consumer Electronics and Computer Engineering (ICCECE)
abstract: We first established the information closed-loop technology system of “disaster prediction-disaster monitoring - disaster analysis” galloping and wind deviation in the whole business process to provide anti galloping support for electric power equipment management departments relying on 200+ galloping and wind deviation sensors in eastern Mongolia. The galloping and wind deviation sensors converse and intelligently analyze data protocol to judge galloping occurrences and research galloping development based on artificial intelligence and tower edge gateway. It alarms in real-time when galloping or wind deviation occurs. The intelligent edge gateway packages the data such as acceleration, speed, displacement, and environmental parameters and transmits them to the transmission line of galloping monitoring and warning system through a wireless ad hoc network. During the freezing rain and snow disaster in northeast China from 2020 to 2021, the galloping and wind deviation sensors successfully monitored and generated the data in 500kV Baiba line 1 in eastern Mongolia on November 17, which proved effective.

articleTitle: Research on key technologies of data-oriented intelligent campus in 5G environment
publicationTitle: 2022 2nd International Conference on Consumer Electronics and Computer Engineering (ICCECE)
abstract: With the application of 5G communication technology in universities, it has promoted the progress of emerging technologies such as big data and cloud computing, thus ushering in a new stage of development for the construction of smart campus. As a unified identity authentication platform and a comprehensive information service entrance, the smart campus information portal provides convenient, personalized and intelligent information services for teachers and students in teaching, scientific research, management and life. This paper studies the smart campus information portal, adopts the micro-service architecture, discusses the design and implementation of the information portal in detail, focuses on improving the system architecture, function services and user experience of the traditional information portal, and improves the scalability and wisdom. Firstly, this paper introduces the concept of smart campus and information portal. Secondly, the micro-service architecture and its key technologies are analyzed in detail. The front-end performance optimization based on the Virtual DOM (Docurment Object Model) is studied in depth, and the DOM-DBFF algorithm is improved as the core of the virtual DOM. The micro-service architecture and improved virtual DOM page optimization algorithm are applied to the design of intelligent campus information portal. According to the user needs of smart campus information portal, the overall design of smart campus information portal is carried out, which is divided into relatively independent functional micro-service and basic micro-service. Detailed design is carried out for core function micro services such as personalized recommendation, data center, workflow, unified authentication, etc., and basic micro services are realized by using the complete components of Spring Cloud framework.

articleTitle: Lossless Path Switching Based on Multi-Controller
publicationTitle: 2022 2nd International Conference on Consumer Electronics and Computer Engineering (ICCECE)
abstract: In order to solve the Intra-domain consistency problem in SDN domain, this paper proposes a new method to check the running state of new routes before deleting existing routes. The specific identification process is to send two identical forwarding flow tables to each OVS switch on the new path and the old path through multicast. After receiving the same data packet, the switch confirms that the old and new links of the current network can forward the data packet normally, and then disconnects the old link. Then, the new path is formally used. Finally, the remaining bandwidth and throughput of the new path are submitted to the controller, and the controller re plans the route.

articleTitle: Virtual simulation teaching system of electronic product development process
publicationTitle: 2022 2nd International Conference on Consumer Electronics and Computer Engineering (ICCECE)
abstract: Currently, more and more academic institutions apply virtual reality technology to simulate product Research and Development (R&D) in order to guarantee low cost and safe practice. However, most of the state-of-the-art R&D simulation systems put heavy weight on the special module for the whole process, which ignores the integrity-links among the separate parts. In order to imitate the general process related to design, manufacturing, and product inspection of the real electronics industrial scenarios, this paper establishes a simulated system for multiple three-dimensional models of production machinery with deeply-immersive experience, which facilitate multi-angle observation of the machinery and equipment with ample knowledge in the R&D procedures. Also, synchronous communication module is utilized inside the system to facilitate the information exchange among different users. With the plenty of virtual elements in electronic product development, animation system-based teaching operations avoid the potential risks of industrial operation in the real factory with improved efficiency.

articleTitle: An Algebra Supporting Semantic Query for Graph Data Model
publicationTitle: 2022 2nd International Conference on Consumer Electronics and Computer Engineering (ICCECE)
abstract: Following the massive emergence of graph data such as the RDF graph and the knowledge graph, semantic query of graph data has become a research hotspot. However, most of the existing studies suffer from lower query efficiency of complex semantics and higher query rewriting cost, and so on. Moreover, these studies mainly improve the query efficiency of graph data from the application perspective, with less research on the related query theory. Query theory is a robust basis for realizing queries and their applications. In this paper, we present an algebra supporting semantic query for graph data model, firstly defining a generic graph data model on the basis of common graph models. Then proposing basic query operations and keyword query methods. Finally, proposing association query methods and query optimization strategies. The graph query algebra study in this paper has some reference value for the research on semantic query of graph data.

articleTitle: Research on real-time interaction method of high-speed bus communication based on Docker container
publicationTitle: 2022 2nd International Conference on Consumer Electronics and Computer Engineering (ICCECE)
abstract: In order to solve the problem of pulse interference during communication data interaction, resulting in a large bit error rate of communication data, a real-time interaction method of high-speed bus communication data under Docker container is proposed. Set the maximum constraint conditions of communication data collection, convert the communication data collection instructions into the shortest path problem, and establish the objective function to complete the collection of high-speed bus communication data. Use the Docker container to solve the optimal communication data point, and use the optimal integration node of the Docker container to adjust the position of the communication data, control the high-speed bus communication data transmission efficiency, build a high-speed bus communication data real-time interactive model, and realize the real-time high-speed bus communication data Interactive. Experimental results show that the proposed method has strong anti-interference ability and reduces the bit error rate of communication data

articleTitle: Monitoring System for Diesel Generator Operation Condition via Sound Signal
publicationTitle: 2022 2nd International Conference on Consumer Electronics and Computer Engineering (ICCECE)
abstract: The Antarctic Scientific Research Support Platform provides energy guarantee for automatic astronomical observation and other scientific exploration equipment in Antarctica. The energy of the platform mainly comes from diesel generators. Therefore, it is very important and urgent to monitor the operating condition of diesel generators. This paper presents a generator operation condition monitoring system based on Variational Mode Decomposition - Fast Fourier Transform (VMD-FFT) algorithm and One-Class Support Vector Machine-Back Propagation neural network (OCSVM-BP) cascaded classifier. First, aiming at the problem of feature extraction of audio signal, VMD-FFT algorithm is proposed to perform noise reduction and feature extraction on the original audio signal. Then, aiming at the problem of insufficient types and number of negative samples, a cascaded classifier based on OCSVM-BP is designed. Experiments show that the features obtained by VMD-FFT can well represent the feature of the original audio data. The OCSVM-BP cascaded classifier based on polynomial kernel can effectively identify faults and different operating conditions.

articleTitle: Optimization Strategy of Ship Degaussing Current Based on Improved Differential Evolution Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2022 2nd International Conference on Consumer Electronics and Computer Engineering (ICCECE)
abstract: The degaussing current adjustment directly affects the control precision of ship degaussing system. In order to effectively compensate the magnetic field in ship surrounding space, a differential evolution algorithm based on dynamic binary population is proposed to optimize the degaussing current. The first subpopulation adopts the central mutation scheme, and the second subpopulation adopts the classical mutation scheme. The algorithm has the advantages of fast convergence and stable optimization results. The results show that the degaussing current optimization strategy based on the differential evolution algorithm of dynamic double subpopulation can obtain the high-precision degaussing winding current configuration, which is convenient to be applied to engineering practice, thus ensuring the magnetic safety of ship.

articleTitle: Super-resolution reconstruction of thermal imaging of power equipment based on Generative Adversarial Network with Channel Filtering
publicationTitle: 2022 2nd International Conference on Consumer Electronics and Computer Engineering (ICCECE)
abstract: Non-contact infrared thermal imaging can help people visually see the temperature distribution on the surface of an object, which is of great significance for power equipment status monitoring and health status evaluation. However, the expensive cost and technical barriers of high-resolution infrared imagers limit the application of high-resolution thermal imaging images in the online monitoring of power Internet of Things equipment. Super-resolution reconstruction meets the resolution requirements while reducing costs. This paper realizes the enhancement of thermal imaging of power equipment by constructing a generative confrontation network with channel filtering. This network embeds a threshold filtering module in the generator part of SRGAN (super-resolution generative confrontation network), and uses channel information for autonomous threshold learning. Filtering improves the stability of training on the basis of reducing image noise; at the same time, the peak information of the image is strengthened through edge extraction technology to improve the network's ability to restore the edge of the image. The analysis of the calculation example shows that: using PSNR (peak signal to noise ratio) and SSIM (structural similarity) indicators to analyze the overall data and edge data after reconstruction, the results are significantly improved, and the subjective visual effect after reconstruction is clearer. Higher engineering practical value.

articleTitle: Study on the spatio-temporal distribution characteristics of bus full-load ratio under big data
publicationTitle: 2022 2nd International Conference on Consumer Electronics and Computer Engineering (ICCECE)
abstract: In view of the demand for the information of full-load rate in bus dispatching and the inaccuracy of calculating the full-load rate in big data environment, a full-load rate estimation model based on bus big data is constructed, combining the IC card information of bus, bus GPS information, bus station information and bus information, this paper deduces the bus station from the boarding station of the passengers, and puts forward the calculation method of the index of bus full load rate based on the IC card of bus, the real-time estimation of full-load ratio and the analysis of the space-time distribution of the full-load ratio are realized, the characteristics of the space-time distribution of the high-load ratio lines in a certain area are revealed, and the key bus corridors in a certain area are explored. Through case analysis, it is found that, compared with the traditional survey method, the calculation of bus full load ratio based on bus IC card information can find more accurate maximum passenger flow section and get more accurate calculation results, the calculation process is more efficient and can save manpower effectively. It can provide reference for the same city to calculate the index of city bus full load rate and analyze the characteristics of city bus passengers.

articleTitle: Research on Star Point Cluster Location Method
publicationTitle: 2022 2nd International Conference on Consumer Electronics and Computer Engineering (ICCECE)
abstract: Various location methods are proposed for the star point cluster images of the interferometric star sensor. They include global-centroid method, circle fitting method and star point average method. The global-centroid method takes the star point cluster as a whole for grayscale weighting calculation. The circle fitting method locates the center of the circle obtained by secondary star points circle fitting. The star point average method averages the coordinates of total sub-star points to realize location. Under the simulation conditions in this paper, in the noiseless star map, the location errors of all kinds of star point cluster location methods are lower than that of the single star point centroid method, and the global-centroid method is three orders of magnitude less than that of the single star point centroid method. In the star map with Gaussian noise, the location error of the star point average method is the smallest, and it is 34% less than that of the single star point centroid method.

articleTitle: An Efficient Application Specific Instruction Set Processor for Multi-tone Digital Halftoning
publicationTitle: 2022 2nd International Conference on Consumer Electronics and Computer Engineering (ICCECE)
abstract: Multi-tone digital halftoning is widely used in printing, image processing, compressed storage and other fields, and it has made considerable development since it was published. Digital signal processor (DSP) or application specific integrated circuit (ASIC) are usually used for multi-tone digital halftoning, but they are difficult to achieve high-speed processing, low power consumption and flexible application requirements at the same time. In view of these issues, this paper proposes a practical hardware solution for multi-tone digital halftoning based on Application Specified Instruction Set Processor (ASIP). Firstly, we analyze the most time-consuming operations of multi-tone digital halftoning, and then we customize special instructions for these time-consuming operations to accelerate the process of multi-tone digital halftoning. Experimental results show that proposed customized processor can significantly improve performance by 4 times, while area increased by 34%.

articleTitle: Application of Synthetic Aperture Radar image processing in magnetic susceptibility inversion
publicationTitle: 2022 2nd International Conference on Consumer Electronics and Computer Engineering (ICCECE)
abstract: Few people use remote sensing computer image processing technology to explore the magnetic susceptibility of large areas. As an important parameter of geological and environmental evolution, magnetic susceptibility is widely used in loess, rivers, lakes, marine sedimentary facies, paleoenvironment reconstruction and so on. In the experiment, the microwave radar image is processed by computer image processing to obtain the backscattering coefficient of the image. The results are obtained by Dubois model to invert the dielectric constant of the ground objects in the Xingcheng study area, the results of the fitting equation are then used to invert the magnetic susceptibility of rocks in the studied area. The results show that the magnetic susceptibility of different lithology is different, the value is influenced by lithology and minerals, and metamorphic rock is a little larger than sedimentary rock only considering lithology. The experiment provides a possibility to obtain the regional geomagnetic magnetic susceptibility using microwave radar data.

articleTitle: Data Distribution Scheme for Information Service Based on Blockchain
publicationTitle: 2022 2nd International Conference on Consumer Electronics and Computer Engineering (ICCECE)
abstract: The main characteristics of data in information service are multi-source, heterogeneous and cross systems, while information service users are scattered throughout the network. There are consequently some urgent problems should be solved in information transmission, distribution security, subject trust, circulation control, etc. Using the advantages of blockchain technology in traceability, tamper proof and distributed storage, and combined with the information service business process, an information service data distribution scheme based on blockchain is proposed. Firstly, the information service data would be encrypted and stored in the Inter Planetary File System (IPFS), and the data addresses are stored in the directory library of information service centers; Secondly, according to the information service subscription/distribution process, a distribution mechanism based on Proxy Re-encryption is designed; then, the information service distribution chain is constructed by using the Consortium Blockchain mode, and the information data and key distribution information are stored on the chain; which is able to better realize distributed data access and centerless access of information services.

articleTitle: Youla Parameterized Adaptive Vibration Control for Vehicle Seats
publicationTitle: 2022 2nd International Conference on Consumer Electronics and Computer Engineering (ICCECE)
abstract: Due to the rotation of engine and the roughness of road, the un wanted vibrations will be transmitted to the seat and have harmful effects on human performance and health. In order to minimize such kind of vibration signals, a base controller with augmented Youla (Q) parameterized adaptive vibration reduction strategy is showed in this paper. The first step is to design the base controller and the second step is to augment the Youla parameterized controller into the base controller. Finally, the recursive least squares (RLS) adaptive algorithm is utilized to achieve the Q parameter tuned online for the further residual vibration elimination. The simulation effects demonstrate that the active adaptive vibration control approach is able to suppress such kind of vibration signals obviously.

articleTitle: Research on Virtual Experiment System Based on Emotion Measurement
publicationTitle: 2022 2nd International Conference on Consumer Electronics and Computer Engineering (ICCECE)
abstract: This paper builds a virtual experiment framework based on user experience design method, uses real-time SAM scale as emotion measurement method, and constructs a systematic evaluation system with interface style, interface color and interaction as evaluation objects, and emotional titer, satisfaction and performance as evaluation indicators. Through the evaluation experimental study based on emotion measurement, through the analysis of a variety of emotion measurement methods, the original data such as emotional state, satisfaction and performance were collected and sorted out.
